Jeremiah Aworetan is a frontend engineer focused on shipping production-ready web products across GSAP animation, crypto, fintech, commerce, and mobile. This file gives AI tools richer context on his projects, stacks, and problem spaces.

## Projects (extended)

- Curtain Reveal (https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/curtain-reveal/): Premium curtain reveal preloader animation concept built with GSAP, CustomEase, and SplitText. Features a fanned multi-image stack that performs a vertical wipe entrance, a live counting preloader, and staggered random character typography on reveal. Designed as a reusable concept demonstrating high-quality motion craft.

- Card Shuffle Reveal (https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/card-shuffle-reveal/): Experimental card shuffle preloader and hero reveal concept built with GSAP and CustomEase. Cards begin stacked at center, fan out radially, collapse back, then are tossed horizontally across the viewport while a full-width typography element grows to fill the screen. Demonstrates timeline sequencing, radial placement math, and dynamic font scaling.

- Circle Wipe Intro (https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/circle-wipe-intro/): Brand intro concept featuring floating food imagery, layered radial circle wipe transition panels, and a mobile menu overlay animation. Built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and GSAP. Demonstrates multi-step preloader sequencing, clip-path animation, and interactive mobile UX within a concept brand context.

- Reelpay Mobile App (https://reelpay-web-link.onelink.me/FMTg/925gmol4): Dedicated mobile platform for content creators built with Flutter and Dart, available on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Enables creators to discover brand campaigns, manage job workflows, build professional video portfolios, and receive secure payments. Core product of the Reelpay ecosystem.

- Noblocks (https://noblocks.xyz): Open-source next-gen interface for moving between stablecoins and local currency without friction. Lets users cash out stablecoins to bank or mobile money accounts, or buy stablecoins with fiat, all powered by Paycrest's decentralized liquidity network across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Tanzania, and more. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion to feel like a modern consumer fintech app, not a DeFi dashboard.

- BriefIntel (https://reelpay.co/briefintel): AI-powered brand intelligence tool inside the Reelpay platform that lets brands analyze UGC campaign performance and auto-generate optimized content briefs from product links. Streamlines brief creation and reduces back-and-forth between brands and creators. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Figma.

- Football for Peace (https://football-for-peace.vercel.app): Immersive animated timeline experience documenting the history and global impact of the Football for Peace (Fútbol Por La Paz) initiative, including UN partnerships (UNOSDP) and endorsements from Pelé and Maradona. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP to create a cinematic scrolling documentary feel.

- Kazlat LIMS (https://lims.kazlatpublicanalysts.com): Production lab information management system for Kazlat Public Analysts. Handles sample intake, routing through analysis stages, approval workflows, automated invoice generation, and signed certificate delivery for clients. Built on Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase/PostgreSQL, and Framer Motion to support a real laboratory's day-to-day operations.

- Paycrest (https://paycrest.io): End-to-end customer-facing infrastructure for Paycrest covering both the high-converting marketing website and the core Remix-based merchant operations dashboard. The dashboard tracks merchant transactions, settlements, liquidity positions, and compliance states in real time. Stack spans Next.js, Remix, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- Surgechain (https://app.surgechain.io): Full-featured DEX trading terminal that consolidates news, pump-fun style memecoins, trending tokens, and perpetuals into a single interface with live on-chain order execution. Emphasizes trader ergonomics and information density while keeping the UI accessible enough for new users exploring DeFi. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase/PostgreSQL.

- Lync (https://thelync.app): Product marketing page for Lync focused on clarity and conversion. Uses Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion to deliver a modern, fast, and easily maintainable site with smooth micro-interactions.

- Noblocks Blog (https://noblocks.xyz/blog): Content platform for Noblocks built on Sanity.io and Next.js that lets the team publish articles, explainers, and updates without touching code. Uses structured content and SEO-friendly rendering to keep the blog aligned with the main product site.

- AI Titans (https://t.me/AI_Titans_bot): Telegram Mini App that turns a tap-to-earn RPG into a native in-chat experience where players command mech titans, battle through encounters, and sync rewards inside Telegram. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and the Telegram Mini Apps SDK to feel game-like while remaining lightweight.

- $Dogatoshi (https://dogatoshi.jeremy0x.dev/): Meme coin community site that explains the $Dogatoshi project, token story, and community calls to action in a bold, energetic style. Built with JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS to keep iteration speed high and the vibe authentic.

- Sesshin (https://sesshin.jeremy0x.dev): Custom brand site for Sesshin built to feel more like a cinematic experience than a static page. Focuses on smooth GSAP-powered transitions, immersive scroll sequences, and micro-interactions while staying performant on modern devices.

- BahamaFoodie (http://hellobahamafoodie.com): Digital ordering and menu experience for a plant-based restaurant in The Bahamas. Offers menu browsing, simple ordering, and delivery tracking built with vanilla JavaScript and GSAP animations for a lightweight but expressive UX.

- RoomLink (https://roomlinkng.com/): Agent-free property rental platform in Nigeria that connects verified landlords and renters directly, eliminating middleman fees. Features verified listings, secure in-app monthly payments, and direct messaging. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion for a clean and trustworthy feel.

- Shape Up Fitness (https://shapeupfitnessonline.com): Marketing and information site for a physical gym highlighting services, facilities, schedules, trainer profiles, and a shopping management system with admin features. Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- Sentinel Finance (https://sentfi.jeremy0x.dev): Proof-of-concept decentralized commerce front-end exploring how a traditional e-commerce experience can be combined with on-chain settlement. Built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and GSAP to showcase interactions without a heavyweight framework.
